# Intraday liquidity (`intraday-liquidity` v1)

Intraday use of liquidity in a payment system: usage through the day and the largest payments.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `IDL` · **Identifiers:** `IDL-…` in `reportId`

Open one with `IDL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: intraday-liquidity
version: 1
description: "Intraday use of liquidity in a payment system: usage through the day and the largest payments."
match: { kind: intraday-liquidity, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Intraday liquidity, id: $.reportId }
strip:
  - { label: Entity, bind: $.legalEntityName }
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Peak usage, bind: $.peakUsage, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Available, bind: $.available, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Usage, bind: $.usagePct, fmt: pct0 }
panels:
  - id: usage
    kind: line
    title: Liquidity used through the day
    key: F2
    rows: $.usage
    x: time
    y: used
    fmt: compact
  - id: payments
    kind: table
    title: Largest payments
    key: F3
    rows: $.largePayments
    columns:
      - { label: Time, bind: "@.time" }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: "@.counterparty" }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
